headline: Shareholder Lock-Ins: 15 companies face supply worth ₹16,344 crore this week
summary: Lock-in periods for 15 companies, including Coal India subsidiary CMPDI, Deepa Jewellers, and EPack Prefab, are expiring this week. A total supply worth ₹16,344 crore is lined up as pre-IPO shares become eligible for trading. This influx of shares can increase selling pressure and impact near-term stock prices for retail investors holding these names.
whats_next: End of week share lock-in expiry dates
why_it_matters: Potential selling pressure on 15 stocks as lock-ins expire.
